grammar.title: 情态动词 May/Might 表示可能性
grammar.structure: 主语 + may/might + 动词原形
grammar.definition: may和might用于表示某事可能发生，might比may更不确定 用于谈论当前或将来的可能性

examples.en: The play may begin at any moment.

grammar.title: 礼貌请求句型 Can/Could + 主语 + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 使用can或could来提出请求，could比can更委婉客气 用于向他人请求帮助或物品，could显得更有礼貌

examples.en: Can I return these two tickets?
Could I have those two tickets please?
examples.zh: 请问我可以要那两张票吗？

questions.q: When will the writer see the play?
questions.zh: 作者什么时候能看到这场戏？
questions.a: He will see it next Wednesday, because the two tickets are for next Wednesday's performance.
questions.aZh: 下星期三。因为那两张退票是下星期三那场演出的票。
questions.hint: 见倒数第二句售票员的话 they're for next Wednesday's performance，以及作者的回答 I might as well have them。

questions.q: Why couldn't the girl give the writer two tickets when he first hurried to the ticket office?
questions.zh: 作者第一次匆匆赶到售票处时，为什么姑娘拿不出两张票？
questions.a: Because they had sold out — there were no tickets left for that performance.
questions.aZh: 因为票已售完——那一场一张票也没有了。
questions.hint: 第四句 I'm sorry, we've sold out 是 sell out 的现在完成时用法。

questions.q: What happened just then, and how did it change the situation?
questions.zh: 正在这时发生了什么事？它对作者有什么帮助？
questions.a: Just then a man hurried to the ticket office and asked, 'Can I return these two tickets?' The girl said 'Certainly,' so two tickets became available again.
questions.aZh: 一个男子匆匆奔向售票处退掉两张票，姑娘答应了，于是又有票可售，作者马上返回窗口再问。
questions.hint: 第六至第九句：a man hurried to the ticket office 与 Can I return these two tickets，return 此处为“退回、退还”。

questions.q: Why did the writer say 'I might as well have them' sadly?
questions.zh: 作者为什么垂头丧气地说“我还是买下的好”？
questions.a: Because the tickets were not for tonight but for next Wednesday's performance; he had waited so long that he took them unwillingly.
questions.aZh: 因为这两张票是下星期三的，不是当天晚上的；他等了很久却买不上当场的票，只好无可奈何地买下。
questions.hint: 结尾 I might as well have them 表“还是……的好”，sadly 点明心情。

questions.q: 文中三处请求分别用了 May I、Can I、Could I，语气为何不完全相同？这说明作者当时的心理有什么变化？
questions.zh: 作者买票用 May I，男子退票用 Can I，作者再问用 Could I，三者语气有何差别？反映了怎样的心理？
questions.a: May I is formal and polite; Can I is the most common and direct; Could I is more hesitant and tactful than can. The writer's second request sounds less confident because he is not sure whether he can still get the tickets after the disappointment.
questions.aZh: may 最正式客气，can 常用直接，could 比 can 更犹豫委婉。第三次用 could，说明作者在遭拒之后不敢确定还能不能买到，语气更谨慎。
questions.hint: 对比第三句 May I have two tickets please、男子说的 Can I return these two tickets、第十一句 Could I have those two tickets please。

translation:
“剧马上就要开演了，”我说。
“也许已经开演了呢，”苏珊回答说。
我匆匆赶到售票处，问：“我可以买两张票吗？
”“对不起，票已售完。
”那位姑娘说。
“真可惜！
”苏珊大声说。
正在这时，一个男子匆匆奔向售票处。
“我可以退掉这两张票吗？
”他问。
“当然可以，”那姑娘说。
我马上又回到售票处。
“我可以买那两张票吗？
”我问。
“当然可以，不过这两张票是下星期三的，您是否还要呢？
”“我还是买下的好，”我垂头丧气地说。
title: Sold out
subtitle: 票已售完

lead.question: 剧院票已售完，作者最后怎样买到了票？为什么反而高兴不起来？
lead.warmup: 去买票的路上最怕听见票已售完。本课里，作者赶在开演前冲到售票处，却被一句 we've sold out 挡在门外；Susan 刚喊出 What a pity，就有一名男子跑来退票，局面瞬间反转。作者立刻回到窗口，却发现票是下星期三的。读时留意四处 may、might、can、could 的语气差别，以及 might as well 传达的那份无奈。
goals: 用 may/might 表达对现在或过去的不确定推测，如 may begin、may have begun
区分 can、could、may、might 四种请求语的客气程度与答语限制
掌握 hurry to、ticket office、sold out、return、at once、What a pity、might as well 等本课词组
理清买票—退票—再买的情节脉络，体会结尾的幽默与无奈
lead.summary: 全文只有十二句，却完成了一次戏剧性反转：may 先营造出随时开演与也许已开演的不确定；接着 sold out 把希望推到谷底，What a pity 顺势爆发；一个退票人又把希望推回来，作者用 could 委婉再问；最后售票员补上下星期三的演出，I might as well have them 与 sadly 收束全篇，留下哭笑不得的余味。
lead.tips: I might as well have them 不是“我可能拥有它们”：may/might as well 后接动词原形，表示“还是……的好、不妨”，不可加 to。

exercises.q: 汉译英：当他发现已经八点钟的时候，他赶紧去了办公室。
exercises.a: When he saw that it was already eight o'clock, he hurried to the office.
exercises.note: hurry to + 地点，hurry 作动词。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 may 改写下列句子，表示对已经发生之事的推测。Perhaps the play has begun already.
exercises.a: The play may have begun already.
exercises.note: may + have + 过去分词，表示“也许已经……”。

exercises.q: 填空：I went back to the ticket office ___ ___.（立刻，两空）
exercises.note: at once = immediately；注意不是 at last（终于）。
pity 此处为可数名词，感叹句须加 a。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我还是买下的好，我垂头丧气地说。
exercises.a: 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.
exercises.note: may/might as well + 动词原形，意为“还是……的好”。

exercises.q: 填空：___ I have those two tickets please?（比 can 更委婉的请求）
exercises.note: could 此处不表过去，只使请求更客气。

exercises.q: 汉译英：今晚演出的门票已经售完了。
exercises.a: Tickets for tonight's performance are sold out.
exercises.note: sold out 表“已售完”，复数 tickets 后要用 are。

quiz.q: 售票员说 we've sold out，她的意思是：
options: There are no tickets left.
The tickets are very expensive.
The tickets must be returned today.
The tickets are only for tonight.
quiz.note: sell out 指“售完”，此处为现在完成时。

quiz.q: “他可能已经把两张票退了”，正确的一句是：
options: He may have returned the tickets.
He may return the tickets.
He must return the tickets.
He can be returning the tickets.
quiz.note: 对过去可能性的推测用 may + have + 过去分词。

quiz.q: “我匆匆赶到售票处”，正确的一句是：
options: I hurried to the ticket office.
I hurried the ticket office.
I was hurry to the ticket office.
I hurried at the ticket office.
quiz.note: hurry to + 地点，hurry 是动词。

quiz.q: 作者第三次开口买票时说的是哪一句？
options: May I have two tickets please?
Can I return these two tickets?
Could I have those two tickets please?
I might as well have them.
quiz.note: 第三次用 could，语气比 can 更委婉犹豫。

options: I might as well have them.
I might as well to have them.
I as well might have them.
I might as well having them.
quiz.note: may/might as well 后直接跟动词原形。

quiz.q: “我马上又回到售票处”，“马上”应译作：
options: I went back to the ticket office at once.
I went back to the ticket office at last.
I went back to the ticket office in once.
I went back to the ticket office just then.
quiz.note: at once 意为“立刻、马上”。
